Her movements were sharp and powerful, and the basketball bounced rhythmically on the rough cement floor. She opened her posture, her eyes were full of confidence and provocation, her mouth corners raised, and she was about to take off to show off her fadeaway jumper, which contrasted with the static Chen Moli and Ye Xiaoling in the background.
splitScenes.lightingNotes: Strong top light creates rapidly changing dynamic shadows on the ground when characters move. Make sure the highlights are not blown out and capture the explosive power of the basketball as it takes off.
